title: Talavera and Zesty Jelly Tart
description: A creative dessert that combines the flavors of tangy zesty jelly and sweet talavera. Perfect for a dinner party or a special occasion.
instructions: Roll out the dough on a floured surface to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a bowl, mix together the jelly, talavera, zesty, and bilo until well combined.
Pour the jelly mixture into the tart shell and smooth the top.
Bake the tart for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the tart from the oven and sprinkle with glassy.
Drizzle the winey over the tart and serve warm.
